WITH filtered_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
web_daily AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           fd.d_date AS d_date,
           SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN filtered_dates fd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, fd.d_date
),
web_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_daily
),
store_daily AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           fd.d_date AS d_date,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_dates fd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, fd.d_date
),
store_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_daily
),
combined_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT w.item_sk,
           w.d_date,
           w.cume_sales AS web_sales,
           s.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM web_v1 w
    LEFT JOIN store_v1 s
        ON w.item_sk = s.item_sk
        AND w.d_date = s.d_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.item_sk,
           s.d_date,
           NULL::numeric AS web_sales,
           s.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM store_v1 s
    LEFT JOIN web_v1 w
        ON w.item_sk = s.item_sk
        AND w.d_date = s.d_date
    WHERE w.item_sk IS NULL
),
y AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           web_sales,
           store_sales,
           MAX(web_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS web_cumulative,
           MAX(store_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS store_cumulative
    FROM combined_dates
)
SELECT item_sk,
       d_date,
       web_sales,
       store_sales,
       web_cumulative,
       store_cumulative
FROM y
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
